propositions: Hardcoded src/rebar directory scan and .github/module-size-limit.txt file references must be removed from git_metrics.py and replaced with scc LOC analyzer and [code_health] config
A new _analyzer_spec adapter must invoke scc_loc.analyze to obtain aggregate LOC and pass (loc, size_cap, size_near_fraction) uniformly to registered size functions
module_size_distribution function must compute count, over_cap_count, near_cap_count, and max_loc with inclusive near-cap band boundaries, returning None for over/near counts when size_cap is None
oversized_module_count function must return count of files exceeding size_cap or None when unconfigured, accepting a uniform 3-argument signature
Context in metrics.py must be extended to include scan_roots, size_cap, and size_near_fraction read from [code_health] config alongside repo_root, since, and until
Non-Python repos or missing analyzer results must receive Unavailable (not fabricated zeros), with analyzer-derived specs carrying source=structural, lens=code_health, and accruing_since timestamp
